title: Creating a GCP Zero Trust Gateway: region, zones, location, IAM principals

prose.text: A GCP gateway is created in the Admin Console with a configuration tab and an IAM principals tab. What each setting commits to is below; the service boundary is in [[cloud-connector.gcp-ztg]].

checks.do: Whether the gateway was created in the intended region, since the region cannot be changed afterwards.
Whether the intercept endpoint group that is being refused belongs to a project whose IAM principal is listed on the gateway.
Whether a location name was set, which decides whether policies can reference the gateway's location.

one-region-immutable.statement: A GCP gateway is deployed in exactly one GCP region, and the region cannot be modified after the gateway is created.

quotes: You can only deploy in one region, and you cannot modify it after the GCP gateway is created.

two-zones-minimum.statement: Creating a GCP gateway requires selecting at least two availability zones for its components.

quotes: Availability Zone: Select the availability zones where you want to create the GCP gateway components. You must select a minimum of two availability zones.

location-optional-synced.statement: The location name is optional; when set, the location object is visible in every policy where location objects are available and is created and synced between Cloud Connector and Internet & SaaS policy pages.

quotes: Location Name (Optional): Enter the name of the location to be associated with the GCP gateway.
This name is visible in all the policies where the location object is available.
This location object is created and synced between Cloud Connector policy pages and Internet & SaaS policy pages.

location-template.statement: The location template selected at creation is the template used to create the gateway's location.

quotes: Location Template: Select the location template that is used for creating the location associated with the GCP gateway.

iam-principals.statement: IAM principals are added with a principal value and a type of User, Group or Service Account, and the principal is associated with the customer's VPC.

quotes: On the IAM Principals tab, enter a Principal Value and select Principal Type (i.e., User, Group, or Service Account).
The IAM principal is associated with your virtual private cloud (VPC).

principal-allows-endpoint-group.statement: On a connection request the Zscaler service checks the incoming connection and allows it from an intercept endpoint group associated with an added IAM principal.

quotes: When a user enters a connection request, the Zscaler service checks the incoming connection and allows the incoming connection from an intercept endpoint group that is associated with the IAM principal you added.
